name: Dr. Catherine Clinton
reason: Her work is mainly medical: her own site (drcatherineclinton.com) presents her as a licensed naturopathic physician and quantum biology health educator, framed around health, chronic illness and her practice, and her book Optimize is a health and longevity plan, so almost nothing passes the health-claim and medical rules. (Her home page shows a Shift Network image, but theshiftnetwork.com was not opened because it returns 403 to us.)
